_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Price of Ingenuity#001.src: Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
The Price of Ingenuity#001.dst: 従来の機関車の型式は、比較的効率の低いエンジンを採用していた。

The Price of Ingenuity#002.src: Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#002.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鋼の羽根の自室で一晩休む。

The Price of Ingenuity#003.src: ...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#003.dst: …え。どこ？ ど、どこ行ったの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#003.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#004.dst: おいおい、落ち着けって！何が―
The Price of Ingenuity#004.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#005.src: My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#005.dst: あたしの弓だよ、Yuman！どこ？どこに置いたの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#005.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#006.src: Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.dst: おいおい、落ち着けよ、まったく！ここだよ、会議テーブルの上！朝方ベッドから落ちてたから、安全な所に置いといたんだ！
The Price of Ingenuity#006.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#007.src: I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
The Price of Ingenuity#007.dst: 別に奪い取ったわけじゃないって！悪かったな！オレのミスだ。お前がこうなるの忘れてた。
The Price of Ingenuity#007.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#009.src: Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
The Price of Ingenuity#009.dst: ごめん。怒鳴って。あたし… どうかしてた。
The Price of Ingenuity#009.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#010.src: Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.dst: いいって、気にすんな！オレも兄貴たちが黙って物を動かしたらイラッとするし！まあ、そこまでじゃないけど― なんとなく分かるってことさ。
The Price of Ingenuity#010.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#011.src: Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
The Price of Ingenuity#011.dst: うん。前にここにいた頃、この話したことあったっけ？
The Price of Ingenuity#011.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#012.src: Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
The Price of Ingenuity#012.dst: いや、なかったと思う。あの頃のお前はまだ誰とも距離を置いてたから、踏み込まないようにしてたんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#012.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#013.src: Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.dst: そっか… そうだね。大したことじゃないんだ。ただ弓が… あたしには大事なの。
The Price of Ingenuity#013.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#014.src: Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.dst: そう、こんなかさばる物を一日中持ち歩いてバカみたいなのは分かってる！でも失くすわけにいかない。必要なの。理由は説明できないけど、必要なんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#014.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#015.src: Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
The Price of Ingenuity#015.dst: いいじゃん、別に！バカみたいって言うならオレを見ろよ！「ギター」で戦ってんだぜ！これ以上バカなことあるか？
The Price of Ingenuity#015.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#016.src: Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
The Price of Ingenuity#016.dst: ぷっ、はは！何、敵が降参するまで下手な曲を弾くの？「お願いやめて、耐えられない！旋律が不協和すぎる！」
The Price of Ingenuity#016.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#017.src: Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
The Price of Ingenuity#017.dst: はははっ！それ楽しそう、やってみるか！でも違うって、これでぶん殴るだけ。Yus が金属板を仕込んでくれたから、痛いし壊れないんだ！
The Price of Ingenuity#017.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#018.src: Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
The Price of Ingenuity#018.dst: うわ。確かに、あたしよりずっとバカみたい。Zeph に教えなきゃ。
The Price of Ingenuity#018.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#019.src: Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
The Price of Ingenuity#019.dst: うおっ、おい！言わなくていいって、カッコいいと思わせとけよ！でも、まあ、冗談はさておき。気分は良くなったか？
The Price of Ingenuity#019.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#021.src: Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
The Price of Ingenuity#021.dst: よし！じゃあ仲間を起こしてこいよ。Quill がもうすぐ来るってさ、話があるらしい。
The Price of Ingenuity#021.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#022.src: Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#023.dst: 待って、彼女は起こさないで！
The Price of Ingenuity#023.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#025.src: Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
The Price of Ingenuity#025.dst: おはよ、Sui！この子、朝は… 得意じゃないんだ。言っとくの忘れてた！
The Price of Ingenuity#025.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#029.src: Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
The Price of Ingenuity#029.dst: なんで起こしたの？えっと、こんな早くに。
The Price of Ingenuity#029.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#032.src: Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#032.dst: えっと… もしかして… 私に、は、朝ごはんを、作れって？ど、どうしよう…
The Price of Ingenuity#032.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#033.dst: たぶん… そうじゃないと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#033.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#034.src: And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
The Price of Ingenuity#034.dst: あーあ、始まった。こうなると不安は止められないね！気が済むまでやらせとこう。
The Price of Ingenuity#034.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#037.src: Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
The Price of Ingenuity#037.dst: ああ、ええ、聞こえていましたよ！では何か仕事があるのでしょうね。
The Price of Ingenuity#037.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#038.src: Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.dst: 身支度を整えてから合流させてください。
The Price of Ingenuity#038.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#039.src: Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
The Price of Ingenuity#039.dst: 意外にも、ええ！ここのベッドは思っていたよりずっと寝心地が良くて…
The Price of Ingenuity#039.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#040.src: However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
The Price of Ingenuity#040.dst: ですが… ふむ。どうも悪夢に繰り返しうなされているようです。
The Price of Ingenuity#040.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#041.src: Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.dst: ある意味、現実が身に染みてきたのでしょう。今 {p} に戻るなど論外。事を成すまで家には帰れません。
The Price of Ingenuity#041.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#042.src: It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.dst: 少々こたえます。ここで新たな友や仲間を得ましたが、これほど故郷から離れたのは初めてですから。
The Price of Ingenuity#042.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#043.src: Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.dst: うん。その気持ち分かるよ、Mora。慰めになるか分からないけど、消えはしない。でも… 軽くなる。楽になるよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#043.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#044.src: Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.dst: ほほ！特に慰めにはなりませんね。ですがお気持ちは嬉しいです。家族が一緒にいてくれて良かった。
The Price of Ingenuity#044.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#045.src: But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.dst: ですが、その話はここまで！Quill が来るそうですね？着く前に身支度をしておかねば。後で皆さんと合流します。
The Price of Ingenuity#045.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#047.src: Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#047.dst: んん… あ、あ、あと五分、S… Synd… ぐぅぅぅ…
The Price of Ingenuity#047.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#049.src: Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
The Price of Ingenuity#049.dst: よし、もう十分寝た。どう思う、矢で撃っちゃう？
The Price of Ingenuity#049.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#050.src: Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
The Price of Ingenuity#050.dst: ぷっ！はは、冗談。どうせ効かないし、この子は寝返り打って寝続けるくらい頑固だから。
The Price of Ingenuity#050.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#051.src: Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.dst: うーん、何を試そう… あ、そうだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#051.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#052.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#052.dst: わあ、ピカピカで珍しい小物がこんなに！Zeph が起きてたら大喜びなのになあ。残念！
The Price of Ingenuity#052.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#053.src: HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
The Price of Ingenuity#053.dst: はっ！ま、待って、ぼ、ぼ、僕起きてる、どこ― み、み、見せて、そ、その小物、見たい―
The Price of Ingenuity#053.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#054.dst: うわっ！いたた… あ、頭が…
The Price of Ingenuity#054.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#056.src: There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
The Price of Ingenuity#056.dst: こ、小物なんて、な、ないんだよね。
The Price of Ingenuity#056.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#057.src: Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
The Price of Ingenuity#057.dst: ないよ！でもやる気は認める。
The Price of Ingenuity#057.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#058.src: Ugh... wh-why are you w-waking everyone up, anyway? I d-didn't think we had an-anything planned today..
The Price of Ingenuity#058.dst: うう… な、なんでみんなを起こしてるの？今日は、な、何も予定なかったと思うけど…
The Price of Ingenuity#058.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#059.src: O-oh! Uh... I- I- I- I slept... fine. G-g-good, even! Yeah!
The Price of Ingenuity#059.dst: え、あ！えっと… ぼ、ぼ、僕は… よく眠れたよ。す、す、すごく！うん！
The Price of Ingenuity#059.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#061.src: H-hey! What's that s-s-supposed to mean!?
The Price of Ingenuity#061.dst: ちょ、ちょっと！そ、そ、それどういう意味！？
The Price of Ingenuity#061.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#062.src: You got in bed super late! And you know how I know that? Because your snoring only started waking me up after that!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.dst: すっごく遅く寝たでしょ！なんで分かるかって？そのあとからいびきで起こされるようになったから！
The Price of Ingenuity#062.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#063.src: I kept waking up thinking it was thundering outside, that's how loud it was!
The Price of Ingenuity#063.dst: 外で雷が鳴ってると思って何度も目が覚めたよ。それくらいうるさかった！
The Price of Ingenuity#063.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#064.src: Wh-what?! N-n-no, that's not- {u}, b-back me up here! I- I wasn't sn-snoring loudly, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#064.dst: な、何？！ち、ち、違う、そんな― {u}、み、味方して！ぼ、僕、そんな大きないびきかいてないよね？
The Price of Ingenuity#064.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#065.src: S-see! It couldn't have been th-that bad.
The Price of Ingenuity#065.dst: ほ、ほら！そ、そんなにひどくなかったはず。
The Price of Ingenuity#065.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#066.src: Or maybe {u} needs to sleep lighter! Next thing you know, an enemy's gonna sneak up on you at night, and you're not gonna hear it because you're too used to Zeph's loud snoring!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.dst: それか {u} がもっと浅く眠るべきかもね！そのうち夜中に敵が忍び寄っても、Zeph の大いびきに慣れすぎて気付かないよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#066.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#067.src: Oh my g-gods... the whole station m-must have heard me!
The Price of Ingenuity#067.dst: か、神様… 駅中に聞こえてたに、ち、違いない！
The Price of Ingenuity#067.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#068.src: It better have been just the station! Next thing you know, the crown's going to raid this hideout, and they would've only found it because your snoring echoes around {p} every night!
The Price of Ingenuity#068.dst: 駅だけならいいけどね！そのうち王家がこの隠れ家を襲撃するよ。見つかった理由は、毎晩 {p} 中に響くあんたのいびき！
The Price of Ingenuity#068.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#069.dst: き、君たちってほんと意地悪…
The Price of Ingenuity#069.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#070.src: Oh! W-wonder what it's about. Do you-
The Price of Ingenuity#070.dst: あ！な、何の話だろう。もしかして―
The Price of Ingenuity#070.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#071.src: Do you think h-he's mad about my mistake?
The Price of Ingenuity#071.dst: ぼ、僕のミスのことで怒ってると思う？
The Price of Ingenuity#071.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#072.src: You heard him yourself, stupid. He wasn't mad! He thinks you did the right thing!
The Price of Ingenuity#072.dst: 自分で聞いたでしょ、バカ。怒ってなかった！正しいことをしたって思ってるよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#072.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#073.src: B-but... Still! Ugh. I'll have to go freshen up b-before he's here then!
The Price of Ingenuity#073.dst: で、でも… それでも！うう。じゃあ来る前に身支度しなきゃ！
The Price of Ingenuity#073.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#074.src: And that leaves one more. Hm...
The Price of Ingenuity#074.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#075.src: {u}, you should let me wake her.
The Price of Ingenuity#075.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#076.src: She's... kind of like Sui, but more intense? In the way she's, y'know. Military trained.
The Price of Ingenuity#076.dst: 彼女は… Sui に似てるけど、もっと激しいっていうか？ほら、軍の訓練を受けてるから。
The Price of Ingenuity#076.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#077.src: So it's probably better if I do it since I know what I'm dealing with!
The Price of Ingenuity#077.dst: だから扱い方を分かってるあたしがやった方がいいと思う！
The Price of Ingenuity#077.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#079.src: You know, you'd think she'd wake up at the crack of dawn with her military background... but nope.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.dst: 軍にいたんだから夜明けと同時に起きると思うでしょ… それが違うんだな。
The Price of Ingenuity#079.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#083.src: I thought I'd be prepared for it, but nope...
The Price of Ingenuity#083.dst: 覚悟はできてると思ってたのに、甘かった…
The Price of Ingenuity#083.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#084.src: We thought you were asleep, Syndra! I was coming up to wake you!
The Price of Ingenuity#084.dst: 寝てると思ったんだよ、Syndra！起こしに来たとこ！
The Price of Ingenuity#084.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#085.src: Well... I'm awake. Quill is stopping by, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#085.dst: まあ… 起きてるわ。Quill が来るのよね？
The Price of Ingenuity#085.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#086.dst: うん… なんで知ってるの？
The Price of Ingenuity#086.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#087.src: I've been awake for a while, Rex. I heard you talking about it downstairs!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.dst: しばらく前から起きてたのよ、Rex。下で話してるのが聞こえたわ！
The Price of Ingenuity#087.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#088.src: And here I thought I was a morning person...
The Price of Ingenuity#088.dst: 私は朝型のつもりだったのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#088.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#089.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Quill の話を聞く。

The Price of Ingenuity#090.src: Ah, hello! Good morning to you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#090.dst: やあ、皆さん！おはようございます。
The Price of Ingenuity#090.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#092.src: Oh, dear. What is with all the formality this morning?
The Price of Ingenuity#092.dst: おやおや。今朝はずいぶんかしこまっていますね？
The Price of Ingenuity#092.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#093.src: Well, Yuman told us to be up and ready since you were coming-
The Price of Ingenuity#093.dst: えっと、Yuman が、あなたが来るから起きて準備しとけって―
The Price of Ingenuity#093.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#094.src: -so, naturally, the assumption was made that you had a mission for us-
The Price of Ingenuity#094.dst: ―ですから当然、何か任務があるのだろうと思いまして―
The Price of Ingenuity#094.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#095.src: -o-o-or that w-we had done something wrong...
The Price of Ingenuity#095.dst: ―あ、あ、あるいは、ぼ、僕らが何かやらかしたのかと…
The Price of Ingenuity#095.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#096.dst: 例えば！朝ごはんを作らなかったとか！
The Price of Ingenuity#096.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#098.src: Pahaha! Goodness, that was a lot all at once. Syndra, are they typically like this?
The Price of Ingenuity#098.dst: はっはっは！いやはや、一度にたくさんですね。Syndra、彼らはいつもこうなのですか？
The Price of Ingenuity#098.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#099.src: They're not usually this snappy, no. But between meeting the brothers and experiencing the Roughworks, they're probably getting swept up in their emotions.
The Price of Ingenuity#099.dst: 普段はここまでピリピリしてないわ。でも兄弟たちに会ったり、Roughworks を体験したりで、気持ちが追いついてないんでしょう。
The Price of Ingenuity#099.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#100.src: Ah... I understand, don't worry. But no, I'm not here to assign you all a mission, nor to scold you, or anything else of the sort.
The Price of Ingenuity#100.dst: ああ… 分かります、ご心配なく。ですが違いますよ。任務を与えに来たのでも、叱りに来たのでもありません。
The Price of Ingenuity#100.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#101.src: I simply wanted to offer you all a starting sum of tickets for the shops. I'd meant to give them yesterday, but in the chaos I forgot to.
The Price of Ingenuity#101.dst: 皆さんに、お店で使うチケットを最初の分だけ渡したかったのです。昨日渡すつもりが、騒ぎで忘れてしまいまして。
The Price of Ingenuity#101.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#102.src: The ticket system is used to ration out food and other items to people that need it. You'll receive a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you'd like, in addition to this starting sum.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: チケット制は、食料などの物資を必要な人に配給するためのものです。この初回分に加えて、毎週好きに使える分が支給されます。
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: もちろん、仲間なら基本的な生活必需品は無料です。仲間を線路で寝かせるわけにはいきませんからね！
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#104.dst: じゃあパン焼いたの、無駄だった？
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: そのようですね、はは！ご心配なく、ここで働くことを強制はしません。
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: それに、料理を頼むつもりなら、ずっと前もってお伝えしていますよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#107.dst: で、でも… 焼きたてのパン、ぼ、僕はちょっと食べたいかも…
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: ああ、もう一つ。訓練場に行ってみてください― Zeph、君はもう行ったことがありますね？
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#111.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#111.dst: 兄弟たちは今そこにいるはずです。共に動くなら、互いの戦い方に慣れておくのが一番でしょう。
The Price of Ingenuity#111.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: 私と Syndra が話を詰める間、彼らに合流してはどうです？
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#113.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#113.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の訓練場で兄弟たちを探す。

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#114.dst: …本当にまた出かけなきゃならないのか？
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: 依頼は滅多にないんだ。取れる仕事は取らないと。
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#116.dst: なんでいつも兄貴と Yus ばっかり出てくんだよ？！たまには― たまには自分を大事にしろって！
The Price of Ingenuity#116.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#120.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#120.dst: いや、後でいい。Quill に言われて来たのか？
The Price of Ingenuity#120.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#121.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#121.dst: ええ、その通り。互いの戦い方を知っておくといいと勧められまして！
The Price of Ingenuity#121.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#122.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#122.dst: 悪くない考えだ。俺と Yuman で腕前を見せてやるよ、な？
The Price of Ingenuity#122.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: まあ、Zeph と {u} とオレはもうやったけどな！二人ともいい動きだった！呪われし者の戦いを見られたのは最高だった…
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#126.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#126.dst: ああ！昔話を聞いては思ってたんだ… そういう力ってめっちゃカッコいいって。オレにもあればって思ったこともある！もちろん、悪者にはならずにな。
The Price of Ingenuity#126.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: そんな力があったら、お前はもっと手に負えないだろ。でもその話だが― Quill が、お前らが練習してるとか… 何て言ったか… 「魔法」？
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#128.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#128.dst: 何？！おい、お姫様、この前はなんで何も見せなかったんだよ？
The Price of Ingenuity#128.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: 無神経だぞ、Yuman。そう簡単に… 身につくもんじゃない。
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: Quill から少し聞いた話じゃ、祝福を一つ極めるのに何年もかかるらしい… だから火花一つ出せなくても驚かないね！あ、悪気はないぞ。
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#132.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#132.dst: そ、それなら… お、お、驚かせてみせるよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#132.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: はっ、隠し芸があるのは君らだけだと思った？僕だって奥の手の一つや二つ、袖に隠してるさ！
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: ただの言い回しだよ、バカ。人のこと言えるか。なんで半裸なんだよ？
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: 腹筋を見せるために決まってんだろ。とにかく、{u}、誰から行くか決めてくれよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: 誰、僕？悪いけど、みんなが終わるまで見学させてもらうよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: 最後に一番いいのを取っとかないとね？へへ。
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#140.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.dst: 次は弦に隙間がなくなるまで矢をつがえてやる…
The Price of Ingenuity#140.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: こ、今夜またここに来なきゃ！
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: 波紋が、私の中で静かに広がってるみたい…
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: 力の成長がこれほど鮮明に見えるとは…
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: くそ、過負荷にしちまったか。充電サイクルに回さないと…
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#147.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.dst: で。魔法、呪い、祝福… 呼び方は何でもいいけど、あたしには効かなかった。どうも… しっくりこない。
The Price of Ingenuity#147.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: ああ、ご心配なく、Rex！魔法がなくとも、この地方にあなたほど弓の正確な者はいません。
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#149.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.dst: そ、そうだよ！それに Rex が、ま、魔法まで使えたら、ぼ、僕らには、ふ、不公平すぎる！
The Price of Ingenuity#149.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: はいはい。とにかく、新しい技を練習してたんだ… うまくいくか見てて。
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#151.dst: …それ、本当に魔法じゃないのか？
The Price of Ingenuity#151.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: うん！全部の矢を一度に弦につがえてるだけ。それでずっと広い範囲を撃てるの！
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: でも… どうやって全部の矢を狙い通りに当てたんだ？！そんなの… ありえない！
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#154.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.dst: ふふ。さあ、もっと褒めて。実はあんなにたくさんの矢を一度に撃ったの、初めてだったんだ… うまくいって良かった！
The Price of Ingenuity#154.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: は… 初め… 練習したって言ったよな！初めてってどういうことだ？！
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: うん？理論上は練習したよ。頭の中で。ついてきてよ、Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#158.dst: 「火花一つ出せない」んだっけ？
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.dst: 分かった、分かったよ！俺の間違いだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.dst: えっと… まず言いたいんだけど、ま、毎晩ここに来てたんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.dst: ど、どうしてもできないのが恥ずかしくて。
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#163.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.dst: だって、Mora の魔法、す、すごい速さで伸びたし！
The Price of Ingenuity#163.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: それに S、Sui も！君は、て、天才だもん。
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.dst: あたしなんか今でも魔法を一つも使えないよ。何を恥ずかしがるの？
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: Rex は魔法なんて、い、いらないくらい頼りになる！世界一の弓使いだもん！
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: ぼ、僕にはそんな腕はない！剣の腕も、た、足りない！何度も、た、助けてもらった。
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: それに {u}、あんなに教えてもらったのに、が、がっかりさせた気がして。
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: Zeph とはあまり話してないけどさ。魔法の裏にある科学を知る限り、できないからって自分を責めなくていい。
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: 一生かけて魔法を研究する人だってたくさんいる。君もいつかきっとできるさ。
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: あ、ありがとう、Yusanu。でも、やっと、つ、つかめた気がするんだ…
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: やっと魔法ってものが、す、少し分かってきた気がする！
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: れ、練習はやめない！み、み、みんなに追いつくまでは！
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#175.dst: えっと、やらなきゃだめ？
The Price of Ingenuity#175.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: いいじゃんか！見せてくれよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: …わかった。えっと、少し練習してみたの、今は私… うん。
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#178.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.dst: まだ完成してないけど、新しい技があって…
The Price of Ingenuity#178.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: わ、わあ！な、な、何もないところから作ったみたい！
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: …うっ！すごく集中がいるの… 一言でも話しかけられると失敗しちゃう…
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.dst: それと。何もないとこからじゃないの。
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: なんていうか… 私の周りに渦巻くエネルギーの海があって。少しを… バケツみたいなのに汲めれば、使えるの。でも… えっと、落ちて飲み込まれずに汲む方法が分からなくて。
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.dst: え… あ、あんまり、でも―
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#190.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.dst: わ… 私は平気。ううん、むしろ… それ以上…
The Price of Ingenuity#190.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#191.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.dst: なんだか… やっとこの力の満ち引きを感じられたの、ただ… あふれ出すだけじゃなくて、私…
The Price of Ingenuity#191.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#192.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.dst: …あっ！みんな大丈夫？みんな… 平気そう。よかった…
The Price of Ingenuity#192.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: 私は… これで全部かな。
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: よろしい！進歩をお見せするのに、またとない機会です！
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: 槌での戦いには自信がありますが、それは… ありきたり。ですから、鍛えてきた魔法をお見せしましょう！
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.dst: …おやおや。こんなに強くなっているとは！まだ制御を身につけねばならないようです…
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: 壊してしまって申し訳ありません。弁償をお望みなら、喜んでいたします。
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: ああ、気にしないで。ただの訓練室だし。それに、ここのガラクタはもう動かないから。
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: おい、今のイカしてたぜ！お前の呪いすげえな。
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: そうですか！確かにそうかもしれませんね、はは！使い方を学ぶ機会を得られて良かった。
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#202.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#202.dst: 以上です。次はどなたが？
The Price of Ingenuity#202.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: オレの本気を見せてやるよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: よく見て学べよ、お姫様。オレの本気のプレイなんて毎日は見られないぜ。
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#206.dst: でも待った！まだ終わりじゃないぜ！
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: オレのソニックブーマーは守りにも使えるんだ！一芸だけじゃない― どんなジャンルの戦いもこなせるぜ！
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#208.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.dst: そしてバーン！オレとソニックブーマーの今日のステージはここまで！
The Price of Ingenuity#208.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: 言っとくが、俺は Yuman ほど… 直球じゃない。でも戦いならやれる。
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#213.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.dst: まあ… そうだな？Yusanu が作ってくれたんだ。電撃ブラスターって呼んでる。
The Price of Ingenuity#213.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: もっと強力な大きい一撃も撃てるが、そうすると… 精度が落ちる。
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#215.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#216.dst: よーし！さて… 何から始めようかな…
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: うわ、嘘だろ… また？！マジで？！もう！
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.dst: Yulie、Yuman、トンネルに侵入者がいないか見てきてくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#219.dst: 必要ならな。状況は知らせてくれよ？
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.dst: うん。他のみんなにも手伝ってもらって。僕は様子を見に行かなきゃ！
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: もちろんお手伝いします、指示をください！
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: {u} とあたしは、Syndra に頼まれた大事な用があるの！！あたしたち抜きで大丈夫？
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: 大丈夫だ。どうせ大したことじゃない― ただの定期点検だ。
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.dst: おう！みんな、パパについてこい！
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: な、何？うう… せ、せめて、ふ、ふ、服くらい着てよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#227.dst: みんなが行くまで待って…
The Price of Ingenuity#227.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#229.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.dst: 二人で話せるように、みんなをここから追い出す口実が必要だったの！
The Price of Ingenuity#229.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#230.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.dst: うん、当然でしょ！とっさに思いついた一番の言い訳だよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#230.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#231.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.dst: で、聞いて。Yusanu って本当につかめないの！ほとんどいないし― 正直、今日顔を出したのも驚きだよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#231.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: とにかく、前の警報のときあんたと Zeph が Yuman と出てった間に、Yusanu が何してるか確かめに行ったの。
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: そしたら？いなかったの！工房に入ったきり出てこなかった。変じゃない？
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: どういうことか分からないし、危険かどうかも分からない。でも怪しいのは確か！
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: みんな、今は衝動的に動くなって言うに決まってるから。そんなことない、この計画はしっかり練ったんだから！
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: さあ、工房の前で落ち合おう！見るだけだから。何もなければそれでいい！でも何かあると思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.dst: ほら？言ったでしょ！ただ… 消えたの。
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#242.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.dst: 痕跡すらない… 疑ったのは無駄じゃなかったね。でもどうやって？
The Price of Ingenuity#242.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#243.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.dst: どこかに行ったはず！ただ… 消えるなんてありえない。
The Price of Ingenuity#243.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.dst: 何か裏があるはず！これで怪しむ理由、分かったでしょ？
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: ちょっと探って、あたしたちに危険がないか確かめよう。
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: そう思ってくれて嬉しい。自分が… ひどい奴だって… 思わずに済む。
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: じゃあ、一緒にひどい奴になろうか。
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: 分かるよ、本当に。住む場所をくれて受け入れてくれたのに、今…
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: もしあたしたちが、あたしが間違ってたら、二人とも追い出されるかも。
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#250.dst: 責任は全部あたしたちに来る。追い出されても、他のみんなはここに残れるといいんだけど…
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: …考えてる暇はない。どこかの出口から工房を出たはず。見て回って、何が見つかるか確かめよう。
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の工房で Yusanu を探す。

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: ほらね！あたしの考えすぎだと思ってたでしょ。
The Price of Ingenuity#253.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: でも思ってたでしょ、分かるんだから！
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#255.dst: はいはい、ちょっとはね。でも疑って正解だった！
The Price of Ingenuity#255.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: これで確定。まあ、確かめるまでもなかったけど…
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#258.dst: うーん… 扉が閉まってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#258.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#259.src: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#259.dst: Yusanu ったら、誰にもついてこさせないように徹底してるね！
The Price of Ingenuity#259.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#260.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.dst: でも残念、あたしたちはしつこいんだ。開ける方法があるはず、見つければいいだけ！
The Price of Ingenuity#260.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#261.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.dst: 何をしたか知らないけど効いたみたい、扉が開いた！
The Price of Ingenuity#261.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#263.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#263.dst: 行き止まり？ううん、向こうに何か見える…
The Price of Ingenuity#263.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: どうやって渡る？あんたの魔法を使うって手もあるけど… あたしが連れてきたせいで危ない目に遭わせたくない。
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: あ！Yusanu はこの道を通ったはず、他に道はない。ってことは、仕掛けがある…
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#268.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.dst: 見て、あそこ！向こう側のボタン、見える？ここを通るたびに、あれで道を閉じてるんだと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#268.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#269.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.dst: Fruma 一の狙撃手が味方で良かったね！あれくらいの的、どうってことない。
The Price of Ingenuity#269.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.dst: ちょっと待って… 狙いを合わせて… ぴったり…
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: 当たり！あ、思ったより危なっかしいな。気をつけて！
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.dst: …ちょっと、なんで君主の屋敷の真ん前に出るの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.dst: こんなに警備が厳しい場所なのに、玄関に直通の秘密のトンネルがあるなんて？！
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#275.dst: よし… よし、よし、よし。落ち着け。
The Price of Ingenuity#275.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.dst: このままにはできないけど、正面玄関から入るのは絶対無理…
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: 見て、あの上。アーチが本館につながってる、たぶん中に入れる。
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#278.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.dst: こっちの建物を登れば上に行けるかも！
The Price of Ingenuity#278.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の近くの建物を登り、Soosu の屋敷に入る。

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Soosu の屋敷に忍び込み、Yusanu を探す。

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.dst: …ねえ、気をつけて。ここで捕まるわけにはいかない。
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: でも… やけに静か。変なの。
The Price of Ingenuity#282.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#283.dst: よし。よしよし。ボタン多すぎ。
The Price of Ingenuity#283.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: この二つは上と下… こっちはリストかな…？事務室、工房、居住区、工房 {~}、屋上工房… それになんでレバーが？表示すらないし。
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.dst: うう、Roughworks の機械っていつも分かんない。無駄に複雑…
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#286.dst: で、あんたは？何か考えある？
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: オッケー。他の案と同じくらいマシ。
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#289.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#289.dst: そう。意見ありがと。でも… それはやらない！最悪の案じゃん― Zeph がうつった？
The Price of Ingenuity#289.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: あの子一人でも手に負えないのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#291.dst: ああもう、いいや！とりあえず何か試そう。
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#295.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.dst: 今のは… 話したくない。
The Price of Ingenuity#295.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#296.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.dst: 待って！{u}、静かに、これ見て。
The Price of Ingenuity#296.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#297.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#297.dst: まずい、こっち来る！ついてきて！
The Price of Ingenuity#297.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#300.dst: もし ― あれが ― オバケ ― だったら？！
The Price of Ingenuity#300.speaker: Sparkles

The Price of Ingenuity#301.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#301.dst: いやぁぁぁ！！！ママなら、ど、ど、どうすればいいか分かるよぉぉ！
The Price of Ingenuity#301.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#303.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#303.dst: あの「衛兵」、普通じゃないよね？ここ君主の屋敷のはずでしょ？
The Price of Ingenuity#303.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#304.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#304.dst: あたしたちに気付きもしなかった… まあいいや。先へ進もう。
The Price of Ingenuity#304.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#306.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#306.dst: なんでこんなにすぐまた呼んだの？昨日来たばかりだよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#306.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#307.dst: もう、とぼけないで！兵士が死んだの！任務中に殺された！心当たりあるでしょ？？
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: あるはずよ！もう一度言うわ― 兵士が死んだの！！取り決めがあったでしょ、Yus、あなたはそれを破った！
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: わ― 分かってる。起きたことは申し訳ない。でも― それは僕がここで仕事してる間に起きたんだ！どうしろって言うのさ？！
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#311.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#311.dst: ふん！あなた賢いんでしょ？導電性と電流の基礎を理解できるくらいには賢いじゃない！方法は見つけられたはずよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#311.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: 本当に残念… お気に入りの一人だったのに、Yus。すっかりがっかりさせられたわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: …分かってる。な― なんとかする。何をすればいいか言って、そしたら― やれる。みんなを守れるなら― 何でも、何でもやる。
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#314.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#314.dst: もう、Yus ったらおバカさん。今さら直せることなんてないの。被害は出たし、この辺の連中は誰も黙って！くれ！ないの！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#314.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: 静かにしてると思ったから、あの廃操車場に住まわせてあげたのに。全然静かじゃない！みんながこうだと集中できな―
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: オバケぇぇ！Sparkles がオバケの音を聞いたのぉ！どうすればいいのぉ？？？
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: もう！今はダメ！！ママが忙しいの見て分からない？！
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#319.dst: …あ。あの二人、好きだったのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#319.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: …大丈夫よ。後で戻しとくから！
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: あの子たち、人の振る舞いの再現がどんどん上手くなってるの！最新の作品は推定精度 {~} で―
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: そうそう！あなたにしてほしいことがあるの、Yus。この件は消えない。誰かに責任を押しつけて、みんなを黙らせて終わりにしたいの！
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: 特に北のあのうるさい奴！あたしをほっといて、口出しをやめたら死ぬわけ？？
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#326.dst: 答えなくていい。いい、これしかないの。この件の責任者を差し出して。そうすれば平和も保てるし、友達でいられるわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: な― 本気なの！そんなことできないよ、Soosu！僕に友達か家族を差し出せって、本気で言ってるの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#328.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.dst: いいえ、Yus、あなたに期待してたのは「友達や家族」を静かにさせることよ！でももうその段階は過ぎたの。何か手を打たないと。
The Price of Ingenuity#328.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: わ… 分かった。考えさせて。す… すぐに返事する。
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: 何してるの？！こそこそ君主と会ってるなんて？！
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#331.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#331.dst: 先回りしなきゃ。このまま逃がすもんか。ついてきて、急いで！
The Price of Ingenuity#331.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: 行こう！トンネルに入る前に先回りできるか見てみよう！
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#333.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Yusanu の帰りを待つ。

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: よし。ここなら隠れて待つのにちょうどいい…
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#335.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: 信じられない！あいつ、信じられない！いつからこんなことしてたの？
The Price of Ingenuity#335.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: 僕は… えっと、また後でね、たぶん…
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#340.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#340.dst: 何も言わないで、Yusanu。質問できる立場じゃないよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#340.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#341.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#341.dst: 君主とこっそり会ってた？本気？正気なの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#341.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#342.dst: き― 君たち… つけてきたの… ああ、そんな… だめだめだめ… 見られてないよね？全部台無しに―
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#343.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.dst: あたしたちが台無しにする？！こそこそ君主に会いに行ってるあんたじゃなくて？！
The Price of Ingenuity#343.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#344.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#344.dst: 分かってない！僕らが下で安全なのは、僕が彼女と取引した「から」なんだ！！
The Price of Ingenuity#344.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: 彼女の工房で助手として働いて、進めてる計画を手伝う。その代わり、僕らは駅に住まわせてもらってるんだ！
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#347.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#347.dst: 少なくとも兵士と揉めない限りはね― それを起こしたのは、言わせてもらえば君たちだろ？だから― そんな顔…
The Price of Ingenuity#347.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: 何それ、このバカ。いつまで秘密にするつもりだったの？誰かに話す気はあった？
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: 誰かが兵士を怒らせるまで放っておくつもりだった？いずれ必ずそうなってたよ、信じて。あたしたちがいてもいなくても。
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#351.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.dst: 状態: 保留。彼女は他のことに私の力を必要としている。

The Price of Ingenuity#352.dst: …この方が安全だと思ったんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#352.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#353.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#353.dst: うわっ！き― 聞こえてたの？
The Price of Ingenuity#353.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#355.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#355.dst: うう… 分からない！分からないよ。もちろんやりたくない！君たちはいい人だし、そんなふうに誰かを追い出すなんて、僕らの決まりに全部反する！
The Price of Ingenuity#355.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: でも… 選択肢はないと思う。鋼の羽根の安全がかかってる。誰かを― ただ― 差し出せば解決する、でも― 僕は― できない。そんなことできないよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#358.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.dst: 分かった。あんたは正しいと思うことをしてた。それは分かる。でもこれは― 秘密を抱えて、奴らのルールに従う― うまくいくはずなかった！
The Price of Ingenuity#358.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.dst: この選択は、元々やってたことで乗り越えられる― 王家を倒すこと！成功すれば、あんたたちにもう危険はない。
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: 償うチャンスだよ、Yusanu！あんたは情報を持ってる。君主と何を作ってたのか教えて。重要なもの？
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: …それが何なのかは… よく知らない。武器じゃないのは確か― Soosu がはっきり言ってた。女王から… 重要な任務なんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#363.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.dst: 変― 変なんだ。すごく、すごく変。聞いた感じ… ありえない科学を使ってる。女王が元々持ってた装置の上に作ってるみたい。
The Price of Ingenuity#363.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: Soosu は… この計画で追い詰められてる。完成させなきゃいけないのに、ふ― 不可能に思える。何かがかかってるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: …謎の装置、王家にとって重要… 分かった。{u}、Yusanu― それを盗もう。王家にとって大事なら… 何をするものであれ、渡さない方がいい。
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#366.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.dst: な― 何？！本気なの！そんなこと―
The Price of Ingenuity#366.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: できるし、やるべき！君主たちは友達じゃないよ、Yusanu。Fruma のあらゆる悪の共犯で、責任者なんだから！！
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: 奴らに打撃を与えれば、王家に打撃を与えられる。王家に打撃を与えられれば… 本当に勝ち目があるかも。
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.dst: …分かった。分かったよ！君の言う通り。君の… 言う通りだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: そこまで案内できる。えっと… そもそもどうやって入ったの？
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: 見せてあげる。さあ、もう一度中へ。
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#373.dst: …それだけの価値があるといいけど。
The Price of Ingenuity#373.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: Yusanu について Soosu の工房へ行く。

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.dst: よし、急がないと。Soosu はほとんど工房にいるから…
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.dst: 僕は… たぶん大丈夫。でも君たち二人を見られたら…
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#378.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.dst: つまり捕まるなってことね。戦っても勝ち目はないよね？
The Price of Ingenuity#378.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#379.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.dst: ない！！ないない、絶対ない。彼女の祝福… 戦いで使うのは見たことないけど、何ができるか知ってると…
The Price of Ingenuity#379.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#380.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.dst: 物質を形作れるってことは… ただ機械を組むだけじゃ済まない。だから…
The Price of Ingenuity#380.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: そうはならないよ。さあ、行こう。
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#382.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...
The Price of Ingenuity#382.dst: 工房の扉はすでに開いている…

The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: 量子転位モジュール - 研究ノート

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: よし、降りる前に― Soosu の工房にはゴーレムがたくさん歩き回ってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.dst: Sparkles や Glitter より… えっと、高性能なんだ。見つかったら警報が鳴る。だから捕まらないで！
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#388.dst: 二人ともどうやって僕を見つけたの？
The Price of Ingenuity#388.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#389.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.dst: 本当に？よくそれまでシステムが持ったね… 驚きだよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#389.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#390.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.dst: ちょっと、この… 機械に説明書が付いてないのはあたしたちのせいじゃないから！
The Price of Ingenuity#390.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#391.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.dst: はは！まあ、ちょっと分かりにくいよね。行き先を選んで、上か下を押して、レバーを引いて起動！簡単。
The Price of Ingenuity#391.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: それ… 合ってるけど、言い方が気になるな。実際何があったの？
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: うう、何があったかはどうでもいい。問題はこの馬鹿な箱が無駄に複雑でイライラするってこと！
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: 分かった、分かったよ！まあ… ちょっと分かりにくいよね。行き先を選んで、上か下を押して、レバーを引いて起動！簡単。
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.dst: …ちなみに、音楽は僕が選んだんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: うわ… ここがこんなに散らかってたの忘れてた。
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.
The Price of Ingenuity#398.dst: 衛兵を避けて屋敷を忍び進む。

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#399.dst: よし！目的地はあそこだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: Soosu の工房で一番重要な区画だよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.dst: Soosu の工房で装置を探す。

The Price of Ingenuity#402.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.dst: 本当に彼女はここに来ないんだよね？
The Price of Ingenuity#402.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: えっと… だいたいは。{~} 確実。急げば今日は大丈夫なはず。
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.dst: 祭りが近いから、やることが山ほどあるんだ。他の工房の片付けや、今年の祭りに要る仕掛けづくりで忙しいはず… そういうこと。
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.dst: ここに来るのは大きな計画のときだけ。まあ、うっぷん晴らしのときもだけど。でも今日は何もないから… 安全だよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: …あんたがそう言うなら、Yusanu。でも早くここを出たい。
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: うん… 同感。装置を取って行こう。
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: ここは工房で Soosu のお気に入りの部屋。ゴーレム製作室だよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.dst: 彼女… 植物をいじるのが好きだって言ってた。だからゴーレムの多くは植木鉢と土でできてるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: うーん。まあ、祝福をこういうことに使ってくれて良かった。… 世界ごと作り変えるとかじゃなくて？
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: ま、またゴーレム？引き返す？
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: あ、Flowers だ！Soosu のお気に入りのゴーレムだよ！でもなんで Flowers ベッドじゃなくてここで寝てるんだろ。… その名前付けたのは僕じゃないからね。
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: やっと！！！いいって言ってくれた！！！T おじさんがやっと工房に入れてくれるの、すっごく楽しみ！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: 本物になった！！Flowers が本物になったの！！！！お母さんに絵を見せたら、縫うのを手伝ってくれた！！これで Fiona とおそろい！Fiona には Daruma、私には… Flowers！
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: ふん。ふん！！！！！！！！Fiona はもう大きいから働かなきゃいけない… いつも疲れてて、もう遊んでくれない！！！！最悪。最悪！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: T おじさんが超ウルトラ自動乳しぼり機を一緒に作ってくれるって！！
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: ぐるるる… ずーっと書いてなかった… 働かなきゃいけないから！！！！畑で！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: ずっと本を読んでた！！たっくさん読んだ… 農業の本を！
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: 今年もあの時期が来た！！王家の祭り！！！あと一週間！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: 今日変なことがあった。T おじさんが軍の変な人を連れて帰ってきた、豪華な制服まで着て！
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: なんと、王家が私のすごすぎ農夫マシンを気に入ってくれた！！作物の収穫とかが楽になるから、もっと作ってほしいって。みんなの仕事が速くなるように！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.dst: うう… うううう… ううううう… すっごく疲れた！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: 今日、T おじさんが大けがをした。すごく、すごく、すごくひどいけが。
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: お母さんは T おじさんは大丈夫だって。きっと大丈夫。
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: 締め切りって、実は簡単なのかも？
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: よし。大きなことが起きてる！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: 城塞は最高だった！！！いつか上に行くのがずっと夢だった… そして行けた！！
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: エ・レ・キ計画は進行中(そう、名前変わった… 前の名前、君主が気に入らなかったの… ちぇっ。)、すごく順調！！
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: よし！！！落ち着いて！！！！でも大変なことが！起きてる！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#432.dst: なんだか… 変な気分。
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: 0 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: この記録を読み返すと、私… 空っぽな気がする。
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: 数日前、お母さんが病気で亡くなった。前から分かってたらしいけど… それでもショックだった。
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: もうこれを書く意味なんてある？何を書けばいいか分からない。計画のことや進歩のことは書けるけど、全部空っぽに感じる。
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: 何年経ったんだろう？日付を見れば分かるけど… 見たくない。
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: 決して忘れるな、創り続けろ、決して屈するな！
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: あった… こうして見ると、本当にすごいな。
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: もう一回聞くけど、本当に何のためのものか知らないの？それより、誰が運ぶ？
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: 安全な所に出るまでは {u} が持つべきだと思う。それと… 本当に、全然知らないんだ。Soosu に詳しく聞くたび、はぐらかされてた。
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: そう。何にせよ、王家が欲しがるならろくなものじゃない。{u}、準備はいい？
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: 待って。あの音、聞こえる？足音？
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: それしかない― しかも二人分。Soosu が来てる、でも誰と…？
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: …本当にこれが最善か？議論と君の… 計画に注意を割くのは… 過去にうまくいった試しがない。
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: あのね、Zhiraok、「みーんな」が何もかも放り出して自分の地域を離れる暇があるわけじゃないの。あたしたちには仕事があるのよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: あら、ここにいたのね、Flowers！起きて起きて、お寝坊さん― 見張りのお仕事に戻るのよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: 注意しろ、Soosu！急に止まるなら一言くれないか？
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: ん？あ、ごめんごめん、でも親友とばったり会えるなんてすっごく嬉しいんだもん！その頭にもそれを分かる余地くらいあるでしょ、ね？
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu
