The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu… それは解決済みの問題だ！何度言えば分かる？…まあいい、それは脱線だ。本当に伝えたいのは―
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: 見つからずに工房から脱出する。

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Soosu が来た？しかもよりによって Zhiraok と？！今すぐ出なきゃ！
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: うん、でも Soosu はきっと Flowers を厳戒態勢にしてる！魔法は使わないで、何があっても見つからないで！
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: 待って― 何、Flowers？侵入者？！装置室のすぐそば？！
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: …！！呪われし者だ！！彼女には指一本触れさせんぞ、分かったか？！
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: な、何事だ、侵入者め！今度こそ逃がさんぞ！
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Yusanu？！一緒にいるのは誰？待って、装置を盗む気？！
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: ちょっと、逃げるとこでしょ！真面目にやってる？！
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: …君ほど賢ければ繰り返す必要などないはずだ！分かっているだろう！頼む、問題を真剣に考えてくれ！
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: 君の象限に犯罪者の一団がいる。Torann の虐殺を起こした呪われし者も一緒だ、奴らは潜入―
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: もう、Z、分かったってば！！！あんたはいつもベラベラベラベラ「ベラ」！！！考える余裕をちょうだい！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: 犯罪者がどうの、呪われし者がどうの！！！！そう、大事なのは分かってる！Flowers、これしっかり押さえててくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: 君の焦点が解決策にあるならいい、君の… だがな、Soosu、君から何の報告も受けていない。重要な情報を人づてに知る羽目になった！
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 君の指揮官の一人が要点をまとめてくれた。君から聞くべきだった！で… 君の狙いは何だ？問題を無視しているように見える。
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: …Soosu？Soosu、聞いているのか？質問したんだぞ！
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: ん？はいはい、そうね。ねえ、ボルト取ってくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: …分かった、いいだろう― だが頼む、この件に決着をつけねば、Soosu。君も関わるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: あ、そうだ、Flowers のこと。歩いてる間に使えそうな部品を拾ってないか見てきてくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: ここで作業させるのは不合理だと分かっていた。君のおもちゃより大きな問題の総和があるんだ！子供のように振る舞っているが、君は子供じゃない！
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: 本気を出せば素晴らしい仕事ができるのは分かっている！なぜ高位の離反者と呪われし者が互いの脅威を指数的に増しているのを無視する？！
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#474.dst: 自分の方があたしより上だと思ってるの、Zhiraok？
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: ほら見て、Soosu はいつも不注意で何も分かってない、いつも自分の管区の事情を無視して、いつも研究室にこもってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: 彼女の仕事なんて誰が気にする？任された計画なんて？！彼女が知ってるってことなんて誰が気にするの、知ってる、「知ってる」のに！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: …ふん！あんたの方が上なのかもね、Z。そうじゃなかったら、あたしたち今こんな所にいないかも！！
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: 私は… … …すまない、Soosu。それは… 私の意図じゃない、そんなつもりは―
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: でも言ったでしょ！歯車 C-{~} 取ってくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: …分かった。この数列の終わりに早くたどり着きたいだけだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: それはお互い様。今やってるの。いちいちせっつかないで！！
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your soldiers. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: …もっと気を配るべきだったか。彼女の計画が君の兵士にこれほど負担をかけていたとは。手を貸すと約束したのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Yusanu のトンネルを通って鋼の羽根に戻る。

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: …今の何？！あいつら、あそこで何してたの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ぼ― ぼ― 僕も知らないよ！抜き打ちの訪問？そんな… そんなの思ってもみなかった…
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: で、「うっぷん晴らし」だっけ？！ええ、そうね、君主 Zhiraok まで連れてくるなんて！！いいじゃない！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: 捕まるとこだった！あたしたち― ああもう、あたしたち… 捕まるとこだった…
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: …何やってるんだろ？なんで― なんであんなことしたの？あれは本当に…
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: 「僕」に聞くの？！そうだよ Rex、なんであんなことしたんだろうね？！
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#491.dst: やめて。ちょっと… やめて。考え… させて。
The Price of Ingenuity#491.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: …くそっ。くそ、くそ、くそ！バカで、衝動的で… もう！！
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: ううん、大丈夫じゃない。ごめん、あたし― もう分かってなきゃいけないのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: もう… どうでもいい。今さら取り消せない。これを… 切り札に使える。Yusanu、それが何か突き止められるって言って。
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: 僕も… 分からない。深く関わったことがないから… 全然見当がつかない。調べれば何か分かるかも。でも…
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back to. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: 十分だよ、たぶん。さあ、戻ろう。あたしは… Mora を探さなきゃ。あんたはみんなに自分がしてたことを話して。
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: …今日のことを隠しとくって選択肢はないの？
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: で、後になってしっぺ返しを食らうの？お断り。行くよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: ねえ Rex、本当に… 大丈夫？君がこんなふうになるの、見たこと―
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.dst: やめて。しつこくしないで。今は。
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: おい！お前ら三人、一日中どこ行ってたんだよ？！
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: ええ、実に不思議ですね！たまたま Syndra と話したのですが、あなた方にそんな「大事な用」は頼んでいないそうです！彼女は何も知らない様子でした！
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#505.dst: …ああ、Rex… 何があったのです？
The Price of Ingenuity#505.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: 何があったか分かるでしょ、Mora。あたし― しくじった。また。
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.dst: は？どういう意味だよ、また―
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: ああ、Yuman、Yusanu を連れて、私たちは会議に少し遅れると皆さんに伝えてもらえますか？今日は他にも知らせがありそうです。
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: あー… いいけど。Yus、歩きながら何があったか教えてくれよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#511.dst: …さて、どれほどひどいのです？
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: …ひどい。君主の工房から重要な物を盗んだの。話せば… 長くなる。Yusanu が自分の分は話すべき。でも…
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: なるほど。すみません、Rex、もっと気を配るべきでした。
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: 違う！違う、あんたのせいじゃない。あたしが― 衝動的になってるって気付くべきだった、あたし… まともに考えられてなかった。
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: ああ。そうでした、あなたはご存じないのですね。前にこうなったときにお伝えすべきでした…
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex には時々こういう… ええ、「気分」がありまして、過度に興奮して衝動的に… なるのです。何度もそれで厄介事に。
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: うう、もう分かってなきゃいけないのに！特にここで、特に今、こんなときに…
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: まあ、済んだことは済んだこと。とにかく前に進まねば。皆さんと会議に合流しましょう。Syndra から大事な話があります。
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#519.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鋼の羽根で会議に出席する。

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra、それは後にしましょう。夕食もずいぶん待たせてしまいました。皆さん揃ったなら始めましょう。まず― Yusanu、話したいこととは何ですか？
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: …はあ。始める前にはっきりさせておきたい― 僕は鋼の羽根のために最善だと思うことをしてたんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: おう、いい出だしだな… 安心感すげえわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman、頼む… 最後まで言わせて。口を挟まないで。
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: つまり。その、その… 王家が僕らをここで放っておいたのは、僕が君主 Soosu の下で働いてたからなんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: ちょっと！話させてあげて。
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: こんなに長く目をつけられずに済んだのも、これのおかげなんだよ、Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: ここに住めるのも、家を出られたのも、街の電気を使えるのも… 僕の協力のおかげなんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: 彼女は僕に才能を見出したって。工房で手伝えば… みんなここで安全に暮らせるって言われた。
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: 誰にも言わなかったのは、分かってもらえないと思ったから。バカで危険で最悪の考えだって思うだろ。僕らの問題の元凶と… 手を組むなんて。
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: 危険なのは分かってた。本当に。でも僕がしくじっても、罰を受けるのは僕だけだと思ってた。みんなは安全だって。
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: …さて。皆さん気持ちが高ぶっているのは分かります。一歩引いて、筋道立てて考え、冷静に―
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: 正気か、Yusanu？！数ある秘密の中で、よりによって―
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#535.dst: おい、兄貴、そっとしといてやれよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: いや、そうはいかない！警報はそのせいだったのか？いつから続いてた？決めたとき何を考えてたんだ―
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: 兄貴だってずっと同じことしてるくせに！全部自分一人で背負って、誰にも頼ろうとしないで！！
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: だから― まあ、オレもちょっと怒ってる。相談すべきだった！でも… 今話してくれてる。今助けを求めてるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: 残念だけど、話はもっと悪くなる。
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: 昨日の兵士との衝突のあと… Soosu は責任者を差し出せって言ってる。僕は… そんなことできない。
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: 今日、Rex と {u} に彼女と話してるところを見られた。だから… だから話してるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: …うん。彼女と手を切って、みんなに全部話すよう説得したの。
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: それと… 彼女と Yusanu が作ってた重要な装置を盗んだ。女王がすごく力を入れてた物。
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: それが何で、何をするのか分からない。何のための物かも。分かってるのは女王が完成を求めてることだけ。Soosu はずっとそれだけに… 何か月も。
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: 空いた時間に正体を調べてみる。役に立つかもしれない！僕は… そう願ってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: Yulie、Yuman… ちゃんと謝らないと。後で二人きりで話せるけど… 今は会議を続けよう。
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: いてっ… うん、これは当然だ。
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.dst: …確かに色々あったわね。幸い、君主を怒らせたことは結局問題にならないかもしれない。計画通りなら… 祭りの終わりに王家は倒れる。
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: 私の目標はいつも通り、王家の支配を打ち砕き、この地方を解放する道を探すこと。今度の祭りこそ、その好機だと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: 王家の祭りの間に、女王陛下は死ぬ。
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: 落ち着いて、皆さん、落ち着いて！どうか Syndra に続けさせてください。
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: 簡単ではないわ。でも油断した隙を突いて不意を打てば、可能だと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: あなたたちをいくつかの班に分けて、祭りまでに済ませる任務を割り振るわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Quill と私で出した結論は、仕留めに行くのは私一人。そうすれば何かあっても… 他の誰も責任を負わずに済む。
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: 詳細は明日話すわ。今日は… もう十分騒ぎがあったから。不満もそれまで取っておいて。
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.dst: こほん。ええ、まったく。私たちも夕食にしましょうか。
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: Yuman… 無理なお願いかもしれませんが、今夜一曲弾いてもらえませんか？一緒に過ごせる日はもう多くありません。
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: ああ… ああ、もちろん。任せとけ。
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: では、残りの時間を共に楽しみましょう！
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Yuman の演奏を見る。

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: よう、みんな！いやー、えっと… 今日はお客さん少ないな？
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: おっ、あれ Jiro か？よう！その… 来るとは思ってなかったぜ。
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: いや、ほら、昨日のあと… 兵士の件で、オレにあんまりいい顔してなかったからさ。
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: …ああ！はい。気にしないでください。もう水に流しましたよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: そ、そう言うなら！この曲は聴いたことないと思うから、感想聞かせてくれよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: でもその前に… Yus。Yusanu。オレ… 根に持つタイプじゃない。だからもう謝らなくていい！分かってるから。
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: ただ… もっとオレたちを信じてほしいんだ、な？お前も Yulie もだぞ、はは！だって… 力になりたいから！
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: 考えたんだ。話してくれなかったのはムカつく。でも Soosu との取引が― オレたちを救ったんだ！家も未来もくれた！
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: だから… この曲はお前に捧げる。気に入ってくれよな。
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: ない… ないないないない、どこ、どこにあるの？！そんな… 見つけなきゃ、あたし―
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: みっともないですよ、君主。
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#575.dst: ひっ！じょ― 女王陛下、わ― わ― 明日までいらっしゃらないと… な、なぜここに？
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: 予定が空いたので、早めに様子を見に来たのです。何か問題でも、君主？
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: 結構。自分の工房から失くすとは、どれほど無能なのです？！
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: わ― わ― 分かりません、ゴーレムは何も乱されてないんです！何も検知しなかったのに！
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: おもちゃ遊びではなく効率に心を砕いていれば、防げたかもしれませんね。
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: な― 直します、約束します！約束、約束、約束します、直せます！やり… やり直せます！研究ノートは全部残ってますし、あたし―
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: もう結構。あなたの管区の運営ぶりには寛大でいました。成果が出ると信じていたからです。
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#583.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.dst: 共鳴の織機計画をやり直す… それは不可能です。わたくしが託した遺物… あの魔法は失われた技。複製はできません。
The Price of Ingenuity#583.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#584.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#584.dst: ち― 違います、ノートがあります、し― 仕組みは分かってます、やれます、ただ― 一度だけ機会を！直せます！
The Price of Ingenuity#584.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#585.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#585.dst: 祭りの準備があります。いつも通り出席するように。その前に… 身なりを整えなさい。
The Price of Ingenuity#585.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#588.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#588.dst: 我々の取り決めは無効とします。あなたはわたくしを失望させた。君主の務めは無期限に続けなさい… 祝福はそのままに。
The Price of Ingenuity#588.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: …え？いや― いや、いやいやいや、そんな― そんなのダメ、ダメ、ダメ！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#589.speaker: Sovereign Soosu
